title: Cost Of Attendance
content: The California Community Colleges' enrollment fee is $46 per unit. Non Resident/Foreign Student Tuition is $386 per unit. As of January 1, 2020, any student registered for classes will be charged a $2 student representation fee in compliance with AB1504. Students must pay for required instructional materials. For Academic Year 2026-27, an in-state student living at home has an estimated total of $20,991, which includes Enrollment Fees of $1,380 (based on 15 units), Books, course materials, supplies, and equipment at $1,305, living expenses of $12,537, transportation of $1,206, and personal/miscellaneous costs of $4,563. Out-of-state students at home face costs totaling $32,571, with Out of State Tuition Including Enrollment Fees of $12,960.
